rules.textWitnessedSummary: When Proper Psalms or Lessons are appointed, the Psalms and Lessons of ordinary course appointed in the Psalter and Kalendar (if different) shall be omitted for that time.
notes: paraphrased in normalization-friendly form from OCR; verify exact wording against image

rules.textWitnessedSummary: The Collect, Epistle, and Gospel appointed for the Sunday shall serve all the week after, where it is not in this Book otherwise ordered.
